plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Virtual-team operating model for Claude Code: a CTO supervises on-demand specialists (builder/reviewer/researcher), runs agile time-boxed sprints as parallel streams with serialized gates, and gates every change on top of an elevated adversarial reviewer. Project-agnostic — domain knowledge stays in per-project area skills.

plugins.name: paseo-cto
plugins.description: Provider-neutral, release-driven CTO operating model for Claude Code and Codex: delegate bounded outcomes to isolated builder, reviewer, and researcher agents; review every returned outcome; integrate only source-linked evidence; and report in the project-configured language using a formal, neutral, impersonal register. Models and reasoning efforts remain owner decisions.
